name: rootprint-2h-log-sweep
description: Rootprint 2h log sweep for /iterate Phase 0: (1) rootprint hist -q service_name:fabro --since 2h --interval 15m for volume shape; (2) rootprint search -q service_name:fabro --since 2h --limit 200 --json to a file; (3) parse the INNER tracing line from body.message with regex ^(ts) (LEVEL) span{...}: target: text - collector severity_text/severity_number are unreliable, the level inside body.message is the truth; (4) normalize ids (01M[A-Z0-9]+, ses_*, sandbox_id) before signature dedupe or every line looks unique; (5) scope findings to run ids via run{id=} / run_id= and join with .fabro/journal/<run>.jsonl presence - conductor runs losing journals vs develop/revisor keeping them was only visible in that join. Filter classes seen 2026-09-16: hook-127 (fabro-905d), title/PR structured-output warns (fabro-2e57), .codex/instructions.md ERROR noise (fabro-5c45), preamble_allow_keys warns (fabro-8275).

Conductor stage-journal hook exits 127: automation environment 'default' (buildpack-deps:noble) has no nu; workflow comment expects 'toolchain' env which has it. User UI fix: switch automation environment.
resolution: User switches conductor-fabro automation environment to 'toolchain' in the UI; tracked in fabro-905d root-cause update.
